low_power_modes_summary.disconnected_mode_DM: Logical-off state at the protocol layer; secondary's bus drivers may be electrically off; only an acceptable mode-set command brings the link back to operational mode.
low_power_modes_summary.link_idle: Continuous 1-bits or continuous 0x7E flags transmitted on the wire; per-bit-rate switching power; some controllers gate the transmitter when no frames are pending and an upper-layer keepalive (RR / XID) is not due.
low_power_modes_summary.wake_up: No protocol-defined wake-up mechanism. SoC-integrated controllers may use receive-line carrier-detect to wake a sleeping host CPU.

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning is deferred to the SoC + line-driver IP. The protocol-defined disconnected mode (DM) is the only power-related state in ISO/IEC 13239.
